description: This file contains the implementation of MainActivity for an Android calendar application. It manages the UI for displaying a calendar, loading events within a selected date range, and navigating to an event editing screen. It also includes an adapter for displaying a list of events.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity for the calendar app, handling UI setup and event loading.

classes.name: EventsAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView adapter for displaying a list of EventResponse objects.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI components, sets up tabs, month grid, and loads events for the selected day.

methods.name: setupTabs
methods.description: Configures tab layout for Month, Week, and Day views.

methods.name: setupMonthGrid
methods.description: Initializes and renders the month grid calendar.

methods.name: renderMonth
methods.description: Populates the calendar grid with day numbers and weekday headers for a given month.

methods.name: loadEventsForSelectedDay
methods.description: Fetches events within the selected day's range and updates the UI.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Overrides the activity lifecycle method to reload events when activity resumes.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Updates the list of displayed events in the RecyclerView Adapter.
